Använd förkortningarna: **S** = subjekt, **P** = predikat (finit verb + verb i infinit form), **DO** = direkt objekt, **IO** = indirekt objekt, **Pf** = predikativ, **Adv** = adverbial, **SA** = satsadverbial
**Uppgift 2.1: Enkel satslösning (10 p)**
Gör fullständig satsdelsanalys av följande meningar.
**1.** Eleverna studerar ofta på biblioteket.
______________________________________________________________________
______________________________________________________________________
**2.** Min Mamma köpte mig en tröja.
______________________________________________________________________
______________________________________________________________________
**3.** Maten doftade underbart.
______________________________________________________________________
______________________________________________________________________
**4.** Katten sover under sängen.
______________________________________________________________________
______________________________________________________________________
**5.** Det var så himla roligt.
______________________________________________________________________
______________________________________________________________________
<i>/10 p</i>
